features.title: Models settings and provider onboarding
features.summary: The native Models settings page, the official DeepSeek credential onboarding step and the welcome notice, from one owned fork of the stock row. Behaviour is the native one; the Host reads behind the page follow Host change events in one refresh per burst and only while a surface shows the page's state.
failureModes: A provider directory or settings read failure keeps the last good rows and shows the native error with its Retry button.
Host change events that arrive while no surface shows the page mark it stale; the next surface that shows it reloads once.

externalDependencies.boundary: The settings shell declares settings.section and settings.onboarding and owns the describe mirror the page reads.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Focused tests drive the store with a typed remote and describe face; the scratch journey uses the real shell.

telemetry.reason: Client-only fork: it calls native llm, credentials, settings and session Remote methods whose Host spans belong to core.

verification.testName: registers the Models section and both onboarding steps
